newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to back fewer supercomputer centers - Times.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to back fewer supercomputer centers - Times.

text.p: The National Science Foundation plans to reduce the number of supercomputer research centres it funds from four to two, the New York Times said Monday.
Despite the decline, financing levels would not change much, the paper said, citing officials.
Total spending for each centre would be about $170 million over five years, with $29 million budgeted for the first year, the Times reported.
